name: Maodie

variant_note: Independently AI-generated photorealistic v2 interpretation by Trahex, distinct from maodie--octane0411. The usual jumping row intentionally contains grounded hissing, as requested by the submitter.
description: A photorealistic orange Maodie cat with folded airplane ears, glaring eyes, a fierce grounded hiss, and alternating keyboard paw presses.
